// EnvCloudURL overrides the default cloud API base URL for the whole CLI. The --cloud-url

// dev/staging cloud without passing the flag on every command.

// GetAPIBaseURL returns the base URL for API requests. Precedence, highest first:
//  1. the --cloud-url flag (set via SetAPIBaseURL)
//  2. the SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL environment variable
//  3. the production default
func GetAPIBaseURL() string {
	if apiBaseURL != "" {
		return apiBaseURL // explicit --cloud-url flag wins
	}
	if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(EnvCloudURL)); env != "" {
		return strings.TrimRight(env, "/") // trim trailing slash so callers can append "/api/v1/..."
	}
	return DefaultAPIBaseURL
}

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-23 01:22:31Z)**_

Use `SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL`. It's defined at `pkg/cloud/sync.go:669`.

```zsh
export SPECSTORY_CLOUD_URL=https://<staging-host>
./specstory sync
```

- **What it changes:** it applies to all of the CLI's cloud traffic (uploads, resume and skills), not only uploads.
- **Precedence:** the `--cloud-url` flag beats the env var, and the env var beats the production default. Don't pass `--cloud-url` if you want the env var to take effect.
- **Trailing slash:** you can include one or leave it off, because the code strips it.

I couldn't find a staging hostname anywhere in the repo, so you'll need to fill in the URL yourself. The staging worker is deployed from specstory-sync.

Your login token is issued by whichever environment you sign in to. If your saved credentials are from production, you'll probably need to log in again while the env var points at staging.
